description: This file defines the serializable data class AccountNumberFormatData for managing account number formatting options within the Fineract infrastructure module, including account type and prefix type options and related data.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatData
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating account number formatting details, including options for account types and prefix types.

methods.name: AccountNumberFormatData
methods.description: Constructors to initialize account number format data, either with specific values or options lists.

methods.name: templateOnTop
methods.description: Method to set template options for account type and prefix type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the account number format.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type option data.

methods.name: getPrefixType
methods.description: Returns the prefix type option data.

methods.name: getAccountTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of available account type options.

methods.name: getPrefixTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the map of prefix type options.
